Bootstrap an Alpine Linux 3.20 base filesystem.

## Configurations

Architecture-specific configurations replace the default configuration. The
default is used when no matching architecture override exists.

### Default

| Setting    | Value              |
| ---------- | ------------------ |
| Root layer | Yes                |
| Recipes    | `alpine-bootstrap` |

| Recipe             | Parameter | Value    |
| ------------------ | --------- | -------- |
| `alpine-bootstrap` | `version` | `"3.20"` |

## Behavior

Builds a fresh root filesystem with core/alpine-bootstrap and selects Alpine
3.20. Extend this layer with application recipes and the boot setup required by
the target device.

## Example

For example, choose this base for a project layer:

```toml
parent = "core/alpine-3-20"
```
